POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/domain.description: Creates a candidate and four DNS instructions. Rejects hostnames whose assigned Return-Path exceeds 201 ASCII characters. Creation follows read-only checks of the saved provider bundle and published exclusion. Hostnames inside an active full Cloudflare DNS zone return the generic hostname conflict error 2083. No per-domain provider DNS writes occur. Customer DNS observations remain pending and mail remains inactive. Unverified candidates may share a hostname. Supply an account-unique client_reference to retry the same enrollment safely; reuse with a different hostname returns error 2083. Final public-DNS, namespace protection and runtime readiness are separate gates. Available only to the configured OpenAI pilot account behind a default-off gate. Authentication failures may use the gateway error envelope.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/email/domain.description: Requires an empty body. Schedules an expedited check and coalesces queued or leased work. It does not accept verification results, bypass activation gates, or perform customer DNS checks synchronously. Follow the Location header after Retry-After seconds until verification.observed_at appears or advances beyond the value in this 202 response; status may remain unchanged. Candidate expiry returns 404. Available only to the configured OpenAI pilot account behind a default-off gate. Authentication failures may use the gateway error envelope.

Location.description: Relative URI to poll for the current resource state.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before polling Location.

client_reference.description: Opaque customer enrollment reference supplied at Create. The platform must map customers by this reference and EmailDomain ID, never by hostname alone.

dns_management.description: The customer publishes the returned DNS instructions.

dns_records.description: Four immutable assignments, including one Routing MX record. Included on single-resource responses and optionally on lists; operation examples show the complete set.

content.description: Assigned target. CNAME targets contain the enrollment token; use the returned value verbatim.

name.description: Exact owner name to publish in the customer's DNS.

observed_at.description: Time of the latest accepted observation for this assignment.

priority.description: MX preference; present only for MX records.

required_for.description: Capabilities that depend on this assignment.

selector.description: DKIM selector; present only for DKIM assignments.

validation_status.description: Observation of the exact customer record.

verification_group.description: Either current DKIM alias can establish ownership.

id.description: Stable identifier of this exact domain enrollment.

lifecycle_reason.description: Why the resource is leaving the provisioned lifecycle.

lifecycle_status.description: Resource lifecycle; provisioned does not imply active mail, and completed deletion returns HTTP 404.

routing.description: Whether this exact domain can currently receive mail.

allOf.description: Current Sending or Routing availability for the exact domain.

reason.description: Machine-readable explanation. V1 reasons: customer_dns_invalid, customer_dns_indeterminate, and verification_invalid reflect customer ownership records; rollout_unacknowledged, sending_not_ready, routing_not_ready, worker_unavailable, platform_dependency_unavailable, platform_health_unavailable, platform_dns_invalid, platform_dns_indeterminate, publication_invalid, publication_unavailable, and validation_overdue reflect service readiness or internal evidence; deleting means teardown is in progress. Clients must tolerate unknown future values and treat the capability as unavailable.
